title: Population over workflow selection
goal: Run independently owned Phase 2 workflow-selection demands under the existing bounded fair scheduler without supplying a route, result, skill, truth, resource or new goal.

schema_policy.legacy: All-SelectionRequest sessions continue to emit hle-c7-population-v2 and restore with SelectionEngine.
schema_policy.new: Any workflow-selection session emits hle-c7-workflow-population-v3, records exact request types and restores with WorkflowFinalSelectionEngine.

acceptance.new_tests: All workflow-population tests pass from a frozen tree.
acceptance.legacy_tests: All tests_c7 population methods pass unchanged, including exact restore.
acceptance.regression: All previously accepted inherited and workflow suites pass with unchanged frozen source during execution.
acceptance.audit: The independent population auditor reconstructs fairness, charges, child summaries, feedback counters and repetition stops from raw committed records without importing scheduler, selector or engine modules.

prohibitions: no result, skill, truth or authority transfer
no claim that repetition proves truth, development or exhaustion
